preconditions.description: The input graph is a vertex cactus.
The input graph contains no loops or multiple edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in interesting_pairs)
preconditions.description: All interesting vertex pairs are valid and distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(count_distinct_simple_paths(n, m, edges, xi, yi) == result_count for xi, yi, result_count in zip(interesting_pairs, result_counts))
postconditions.description: For each interesting pair, the output is the number of distinct simple paths from xi to yi modulo 1000000007.
